run.requirements: Dynamic Delta pool discovery without per-pool manifests or governance

summary.building: Versioned Delta infrastructure admission with onchain pool discovery and isolated execution
summary.topRisk: A canonical pool may still contain a hostile token
summary.watchOutFor: Discovery is not automatic capital execution

risks.title: Permissionless assets can be malicious
risks.detail: Canonical pool identity does not prove token safety.

risks.title: Slippage and range manipulation
risks.detail: Deposits require minima, deadlines, and tick bounds.

risks.title: Position NFT custody
risks.detail: Every position must be enumerated and fully exit-able.

risks.title: Out-of-range drift
risks.detail: Liquidity can become inactive and one-sided.

risks.title: Unversioned deployment drift
risks.detail: Bind address, dependency tuple, and runtime hashes.

risks.title: Future incompatibility
risks.detail: A changed position model needs a new adapter generation.

risks.title: Initialization and ownership mistakes
risks.detail: Factory and governance authority must be bound exactly.

risks.title: Custom hook risk
risks.detail: Restricted share transfer behavior needs lifecycle tests.

preCodingDecisions.title: Immutable integration generations
preCodingDecisions.detail: Add future Delta deployments as new approved generations instead of mutating live adapters.

requirementsCorrections.detail: A canonical pool does not need a Sinjoh manifest record.
Discovery must remain separate from manual capital execution.
